title: Wicker Chest
summary: A wicker storage chest with a documented 5 HP Sturdy variant.

fields.Sturdy variant: Medium-sized, 5 HP. A single hit must deal at least 10 damage to harm it. 2.5 kg.
fields.Locations: Tiefling Hideout X 42, Y 65, Reithwin Tollhouse X −120, Y −95, or Angleiron’s Cellar X −263, Y −1083.
fields.Small variant: A second template has the same display name. The pinned source does not list its durability or value.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
